proposal.observation: ZN-E000 CPMLP collapsed: predictions ~140 cycles (SD 1.5) vs targets 104-1402, MAPE 0.4346, Acc@15 0.10, best epoch 1, head/intra_mlp.1 grad ratio 5082x. The fixed Flatten+Linear(100*64->64) holds 409,664 of 585,665 params and assigns static weights to padded cycle slots.
proposal.primary_hypothesis: Replacing the fixed 100-slot inter-cycle flatten with mask-aware mean, last-observed and last-minus-first pooling lets the model separate cells by level and fade trend, breaking the constant-prediction collapse: MAPE below 0.4266 (ZN-E000 - 0.008) or Acc@15 above 0.12, with prediction SD > 10% of target SD.
proposal.question_inherited: Does the CPMLP collapse on ZN-coin come from the static inter-cycle flatten?
proposal.unresolved_from_reference: Whether the collapse is caused by the flatten (padding/position artifact, 70% of params) or by the cycle encoder / optimisation.
proposal.why_this_experiment: architecture.md §3: 'absolute position artifact -> replace static cycle-flatten with masked pooling'; §4 forbids fixed flatten over padded slots; §5 staging: change only the degradation encoder, keep the CPMLP cycle encoder.
proposal.modification: Degradation encoder only: inter_flatten (Flatten + Linear 6400->64) -> masked mean over observed cycles, last observed cycle, last - cycle1, concat [B,192] -> Linear(192->64). Curve encoder (intra_embed + 5 MLP blocks), 9 inter MLP blocks and head unchanged.
proposal.changed_components: Degradation encoder pooling (inter_flatten -> masked mean/last/delta summary).
proposal.held_constant_components: Cycle encoder, inter MLP depth/width, head, Relative Huber delta 0.15, Adam lr 5e-4, batch 128, seed 2021, split 2021, A2-ZN epoch rule, data and preprocessing.
proposal.controlled_variables: Split 2021 and training seed 2021, minimum 5 / maximum 100 epochs, patience 5 after epoch 5, diagnostics every 50 steps.
proposal.expected_evidence: Selected-checkpoint MAPE, Acc@15, MAE, RMSE vs ZN-E000; prediction SD/target SD; per-cell and EOL-band errors (esp. >700-cycle cells); gradient ratio head vs intra blocks; padding sensitivity.
proposal.rejection_condition: DISCARD if MAPE does not drop by >=0.008 and Acc@15 does not rise by >=0.02 vs ZN-E000, or predictions remain collapsed (SD < 10% of target SD). Invalid under the usual protocol/finite/epoch checks.
proposal.minimum_evidence_requirements: At least five complete epochs; finite MAPE, Acc@15, MAE, and RMSE from one checkpoint; sample and unique-cell counts for every domain; gradient, update, activation, prediction, mask, and compute diagnostics.
proposal.required_diagnostics: Epoch learning curve; selected and minimum-MAPE epochs; CPMLP block gradients and updates; activation health; prediction spread and bias; prefix, domain, and EOL errors; domain guardrail flags; padding sensitivity; parameters, memory, time, and throughput.

architecture_addendum.mechanism: Masked summary pooling (mean, last observed, last minus first)
architecture_addendum.evidence: ZN-E000 near-constant predictions, flatten = 70% of params with static slot weights, gradient imbalance 5082x
architecture_addendum.shapes: [B,100,3,300] -> intra_embed+MLP -> [B,100,64] -> masked pool [B,192] -> Linear [B,64] -> 9 MLP blocks [B,64] -> head [B,1]
architecture_addendum.mask_path: weights = mask[B,100,1]; mean = sum(h*w)/max(sum(w),1); last = h[mask.sum()-1]; delta = last - h[0]; no op sees padded slots
architecture_addendum.expected_evidence: MAPE, RMSE, Acc@15, DB-MAPE vs ZN-E000; prediction spread; per-cell errors on 20 val cells; gradient ratio
